title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Completion Discount on Sale, Coupon and Excluded Lines
content:
For an order line on which the registrant of a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry redeems the completion discount — her or his own purchase record of a registry item still in ordered status, as kept in Merchandise Purchases with its price type, merchandise class, regular price and selling price — the completion percent turns into a discount according to the line's price:

1. a line at a clearance, doorbuster or final-sale price, or of the Fine Jewelry & Watches or Designer Handbags & Luxury merchandise class, receives no completion discount;
2. any other line at a sale price, or whose selling price sits below its regular price for any reason such as a coupon or promotion allocated to it, has the completion percent taken on its regular price less the markdown it already carries (its regular price less its selling price), never below zero, so that the better of the markdown and the completion discount applies and never both;
3. any other line has the completion percent taken on its selling price.

The completion discount so found is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Worked lines (hypothetical completion percent of 20)

| Line | Price type / class | Regular price | Selling price | Markdown carried | Discount found |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | regular, Home & Kitchen, sold at regular price | USD 100.00 | USD 100.00 | — | 20 percent of USD 100.00, USD 20.00 |
| 2 | sale, Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | USD 100.00 | USD 85.00 | USD 15.00 | USD 20.00 less USD 15.00, USD 5.00 |
| 3 | sale, Beauty & Fragrance | USD 100.00 | USD 75.00 | USD 25.00 | USD 20.00 less USD 25.00 is below zero, so USD 0.00 |
| 4 | regular with a coupon allocated, Home & Kitchen | USD 100.00 | USD 90.00 | USD 10.00 | USD 20.00 less USD 10.00, USD 10.00 |
| 5 | clearance, any class | USD 100.00 | USD 40.00 | — | none |
| 6 | regular, Fine Jewelry & Watches | USD 400.00 | USD 400.00 | — | none |

## Points of judgement

- Exclusion is tested first: an excluded price type or class gives no completion discount whatever the prices.
- For a sale line, or a line whose selling price sits below its regular price, the percent is taken on the regular price, and the markdown already carried is set against it; the line therefore carries whichever of the two is larger, never the sum.
